_note: Definitions fixed after inspecting benign commissioning statistics only (units, uplinks, ACK gaps). Any later change must be logged in CHANGES.md with its reason.
units: hub->client websocket data messages on tcp/8123, not the first message within 0.5 s after a client data message on the same flow, fan-out copies (same length, other flow, within 50 ms) collapsed
uplinks: NWK data frames (nwk_type 0) with MAC dst and NWK dst = coordinator, NWK src != coordinator; bit-identical retransmissions within 0.5 s and relay hops ((nwk_src, nwk_seq) within 2 s) removed
fab_admission: chi-square homogeneity of per-capture FAB rates across commissioning captures, admitted if p >= 0.05
ack_band: centre = median commissioning gap (gap minus air time), half-width 10 us; pair refused timing evidence if q0.5-q99.5 span > 20 us
missing_ack: ack-requested device->coordinator frame with no ACK of the same seq within 2 ms, counted only while COVERAGE >= 0.8
counter_evidence: 32-bit NWK frame counter per transmitter (aux-header source); collision = repeat with different PSDU or backward step; raw frames before deduplication
newep: never-seen endpoint whose records in any 60 s exceed 2x the largest benign new-endpoint volume at commissioning (min 1)
vol: Poisson CUSUM per known endpoint on 30 s bins, lam1 = 2 lam0, h = ln(gamma0) x dispersion
live: device silent > max(2 x q99 of its commissioning inter-frame gaps, 30 s) while others heard
volr: Poisson CUSUM on units per 30 s bin, expected = commissioning units/uplinks ratio x uplinks in bin, lam1 = 1.5x
coverage: per-transmitter completeness from MAC sequence gaps of non-coordinator transmitters over 120 s windows; alarm if < 0.5 for 120 s
folds: per home, 3 folds: hold out pairs {2k, 2k+1}, commission on the other 4 (concatenated, 30 s gaps)
long_folds: per home, 3 folds: commission on pairs {2k, 2k+1}, evaluate on the other 4 concatenated
devices: two devices with most commissioning uplinks
